newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles sees first half profit on track.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles sees first half profit on track.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected first half retail profits to be on target following a 5.4 percent rise in 1996/97 first half sales to A$9.945 billion.
Sales in the second quarter ended January 26 rose 5.2 percent to A$5.50 billion, with the company citing satisfactory trading before and after the key Christmas period.
"We bought conservatively and there was less pre-Christmas discounting in the major businesses compared to last year," chief executive Dennis Eck said.

"Overall, the business managing directors and support groups have delivered against their respective business plans as we continue to roll out the agenda we developed. We expect the half year retail profit to be in line with our plan," Eck said.
